header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ Encourages Striving in the path of Allaah and Spending One's Wealth for this Cause

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) says, "We Ansaar wished that we had said what Miqdaad (RA) had said. This would have been more beloved to us than having an abundance of wealth." It was then that Allaah revealed the following verse of the Qur'aan:

blocks.arabic_text: كَمَآ اَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ ۢ بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۠ وَاِنَّ فَرِيْقًا مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ لَكٰرِهُوْنَ ۞
blocks.text: Just as your Rabb took you (O Muhammad ﷺ) from your home with the truth (with good cause to fight the battle) while there was certainly a group of the Mu'mineen who were unhappy (to fight the Kuffaar because they were not prepared for battle). [^1]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ consulted with the Sahabah (RA) to march to Badr, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) gave his opinion (in favour of marching). Rasulullaah ﷺ again asked for opinions and Hadhrat Umar (RA) gave his. When Rasulullaah ﷺ again asked for opinions, someone from the Ansaar said, "O assembly of Ansaar! It is your opinion that Rasulullaah ﷺ wants." A person from the Ansaar then said, "In that case, O Rasulullaah ﷺ (if we have to fight them), we shall not say to you what the Bani Israa'eel said to Moosa (AS) when they told him, 'You and your Rabb both go ahead and fight. We shall remain sitting here.' In fact, we swear by the Being Who sent you with the truth that we shall follow you even if you travel to (the distant city of) Barkul Ghimaad (in Yemen)." [^2]

Another narration from Hadhrat Anas (RA) states that when Rasulullaah ﷺ heard about the arrival of (the caravan of) Abu Sufyaan, he consulted with the Sahabah (RA). When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) voiced his opinion (to march), Rasulullaah ﷺ turned away from him. Thereafter, when Hadhrat Umar (RA) voiced his opinion, Rasulullaah ﷺ turned away from him as well. Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) (from the Ansaar) then said, "It is our opinion that Rasulullaah ﷺ wants." Addressing Rasulullaah ﷺ, he then said, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life! If you command us to ride our animals into the sea, we shall readily do so and if you command us to travel to (the distant city of) Barkul Ghimaad (in Yemen), we shall certainly do so." It was only then that Rasulullaah ﷺ gave the command (for the Sahabah (RA) to march). [^3]

Hadhrat Alqama bin Waqqaas Laythi (RA) narrates that after leaving for Badr, when he reached a place called Rowhaa, Rasulullaah ﷺ addressed the Sahabah (RA) asking, "What is your opinion?"
